description: Search DiscoverIA's catalogue of papers in the pilot domains (mathematics, astronomy, machine learning; loaded from arXiv) by words of the title, author family names, arXiv categories (e.g. 'math.NT') or an arXiv id. All words must match; most recent first. Without query, lists the most recent records. 'truncated' true means older matches may be missing: narrow the query. Use catalogue_get for the full record.

domain.description: Pilot domain: maths, astronomie, apprentissage-automatique, or 'all' (default).

query.description: Words to match. Omit to list recent records.

name: catalogue_search
title: Search the paper catalogue
